ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level ratio of high-intensity (light gray/white) to low-intensity (dark/black) pixels, approximately 75:25 distribution across the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant dark, high-contrast contiguous banding along the entire trailing edge. Left lobe exhibits diffused mottling and clusters of dark focal spots near the distal tip. Right lobe features several discrete dark focal spots and vertical linear streaks distributed across the mid-to-outer region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, central V-shaped notch with an approximate pixel-calculated angle of 95 degrees and high bounding-box depth relative to lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the trailing edge boundary with pixel-amplitudes varying between 5-20 pixels; topography is most jagged and fragmented at the distal lobe tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge follows a complex curve transitioning from concave near the median notch to convex toward the distal tips; leading edges exhibit a continuous convex sweep trajectory.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of multiple circular dark pixel clusters (rosette-like) concentrated on the right lobe and the distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of several parallel, vertically oriented dark linear disruptions on the lower-mid right lobe, breaking the light primary pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular, jagged tissue loss and fragmentation at the distal tips of both lobes; prominent vertical rake marks visible on the right ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Single small, high-contrast dark circular mark located on the inner right lobe near the base of the median notch.
